name: change_review
title: Automated change review
description: Given a proposed code, config, or infrastructure change, decide whether it is safe to auto-apply, how risky, and whether it needs a human reviewer.
writes: a proposed change to a software system: a diff summary, a config edit, an infrastructure change, or a dependency bump

fields.context: what the system is and the change's stated purpose
fields.change: the proposed change itself (diff, config, or command)

ask: Is this change safe to apply automatically without a human?

labels.yes: low blast radius and easily reversible
labels.no: needs a human to look first

ask: Could this change break production or existing behavior?

labels.yes: plausibly breaks callers, data, or availability

ask: Which area carries the most risk here?
